description: This file implements a MiniMax text-to-speech (TTS) service class that integrates with MiniMax's T2A API for streaming speech synthesis. It defines configuration parameters, handles API communication, and processes streaming audio data.

classes.name: MiniMaxHttpTTSService
classes.description: A class providing streaming TTS via MiniMax's HTTP API, supporting various voice and language configurations.

classes.name: MiniMaxHttpTTSService.InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the MiniMax TTS service, including language, speed, volume, pitch, emotion, and normalization options.

methods.name: language_to_minimax_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to the corresponding MiniMax language string.

methods.name: MiniMaxHttpTTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the TTS service with API credentials, model, voice, and optional parameters.

methods.name: MiniMaxHttpTTSService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: MiniMaxHttpTTSService.language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to MiniMax-specific language string.

methods.name: MiniMaxHttpTTSService.set_model_name
methods.description: Sets the TTS model to use.

methods.name: MiniMaxHttpTTSService.set_voice
methods.description: Sets the voice ID for synthesis.

methods.name: MiniMaxHttpTTSService.start
methods.description: Prepares the service for TTS generation, setting sample rate.

methods.name: MiniMaxHttpTTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Streams synthesized speech audio frames from input text via MiniMax's API.
